copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 当生成插画时，Claude会按3D纸艺弹出书风格处理：立体层次、纸质纹理、明亮温暖色调（薄荷绿/天蓝/珊瑚橙/奶油黄），并自动构建含书本场景、科技元素等的提示词。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成具有纸艺质感、立体层次、特定色调（薄荷绿/天蓝/珊瑚橙/奶油黄）的插画时触发，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景。

say.text: 帮我画一张薄荷绿主调的3D弹出书风格科技插画
say.note: 会生成带纸质纹理和立体层次的图像

say.text: 用弹出书风格展示教育主题，突出知识树
say.note: 会构建多层立体结构提示词

say.text: 为品牌产品做一张珊瑚橙配色的弹出书插画
say.note: 自动融合科技元素与纸质质感

howto.what_en: When generating illustrations, Claude follows a 3D pop-up book papercraft style: layered depth, paper texture, bright warm palette (mint green, sky blue, coral orange, cream yellow), and builds prompts with book scenes and tech elements.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests illustrations with papercraft texture, layered depth, or specific warm colors (mint green, sky blue, coral orange, cream yellow), for tech, education, brand display, etc.

say_en.text: Create a tech illustration in 3D pop-up style with mint green as the main tone
say_en.note: Produces an image with paper texture and layered depth

say_en.text: Show an education theme as a pop-up book, highlighting a knowledge tree
Make a pop-up book illustration for a brand product with coral orange accents
say_en.note: Automatically blends tech elements with paper texture
